## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

<sub>[price source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/providers/deepinfra/models/Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B.toml): Standard base token rate from models.dev. Provider-specific tiers, long-context surcharges, caching and promotions may differ. · [context source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/models/alibaba/qwen3.5-35b-a3b.toml)</sub>

<pre>
download                       size  score
4-bit q4_k_m                ~22.1GB   66.7
8-bit q8_0                  ~43.7GB   66.7

# 4-bit q4_k_m

# 8-bit q8_0
ollama run qwen3.5:35b-a3b-q8_0
# 4-bit mlx-nvfp4 · mac only
ollama run qwen3.5:35b-mlx
